baseline: same frozen engine and neutral documentation
treatment: same frozen engine and neutral documentation
exposure.exposure_implementation: existing full_skill export only; instruction_ablation is not the primary experiment

formal_generation.task_acceptance: unchanged v0.2 public contracts, evaluator obligations, rubric and numerical thresholds
formal_generation.candidate_policy: Generate fresh candidates after qualified research freeze. No known corrected candidate or archived result counts as a new trial.

agent_observation.scheduling: rolling concurrency <=3; tasks and versions serial within each fresh agent context; never nested agents to evade capacity
agent_observation.assignment_meaning: X/Y are blind labels; a supervisor-private randomized mapping to arms is generated only after actual candidates exist
agent_observation.session_budget_scope: one read-only version observation; separate from generation trials; wall_time_ms=300000; no feedback repair/retry
agent_observation.runtime_task_budget: subject to qualified broker metering for review calls as well; current high setting is not a hard cap

scale.anchors: 1 = very low, 7 = very high for the named dimension. Difficulty/repetition are descriptive, not inherently better higher.

agent_observation.measurement_policy: Only evidence-backed agent_proxy judgments. Null plus reason when unmeasured. No fabricated novice/expert identities, human motivations, consent, comprehension time or human abandonment. Actual tool elapsed time/actions/completion are separately labelled automation behavior.
agent_observation.reviewer_access: Playable artifact and neutral public instructions only. No source-informed prior reports, arm key, hidden evaluator, other submissions or prior conversations.
agent_observation.reviewer_role_separation: Candidate builders/repairers cannot act as blind experience reviewers. Technical semantic evaluator may inspect source only within independently isolated service; log source-induced disclosure.
agent_observation.context_policy: 16 fresh contexts, one per agent. New snapshots and operational independence still require actual qualification; same-model agents are correlated proxies.

primary_metrics.title: Rule correctness
primary_metrics.definition: schema, transitions, rule completeness, objectives, terminal

primary_metrics.title: Playable task success
primary_metrics.definition: validated solution or preregistered stochastic threshold, no hard/soft lock

primary_metrics.title: Valid content yield
primary_metrics.definition: valid accepted candidates / all attempted candidates including rejected outputs

primary_metrics.title: Difficulty control error
primary_metrics.definition: absolute measured target deviation, profile and seed protocol fixed

primary_metrics.title: Content diversity
primary_metrics.definition: topology/mechanics/solution features normalized for symmetric equivalents; not file hashes

primary_metrics.title: QA defect detection
primary_metrics.definition: known reproducible defects detected / all injected known defects; also report false positives

primary_metrics.title: Engine fidelity
primary_metrics.definition: state, event, terminal and input parity; visual review separately marked

primary_metrics.title: Human experience measures
primary_metrics.definition: eight separate human ratings; no simulated human or scalar fun score

statistics.paired_effect: within-task treatment minus baseline; descriptive mean and normal-approximation CI, unstable at n<30
statistics.continuous: sample size, mean, median, full distribution and descriptive normal-approximation CI
statistics.multiple_metrics: No post-hoc primary selection; report all applicable primary metrics and avoid population-general causal claims from convenience tasks

analysis.agent_analysis: Keep every experience dimension separate. Summarize per task and per agent/order; 128 assessments are repeated observations on eight tasks, not 128 independent task samples. Do not infer human-population effects or declare Skill superior by selecting one favorable metric.
analysis.stopping: All108 matched tasks retained,16 registered agent contexts and128 paired assessments observed or explicitly missing/blocked. No optional stopping for favorable results. Freeze defects invalidate affected data; preserve every attempt, issue new version/snapshot before further execution.

prior_exposure.policy: Reuse original published seeds for comparability only; cannot claim a fresh unseen holdout. Preserve known/unseen labels as task taxonomy, not proof of prior non-exposure.

release_policy: Agent evidence may support only an explicitly labelled agent-based effectiveness claim after every qualification gate passes. Original human-study release rule remains unmet and is not silently marked PASS; v1.0 readiness requires a separately explicit scope decision. No automatic version bump or release.

qualification.environment_policy: Current environment and existing authorized services only; no credentials, accounts, permission changes or external messages created by this registration.
